meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理单细胞分析的注释数据矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常处理单细胞RNA-seq数据或.h5ad文件。
copy.tagline_en: Manage annotated matrices for single-cell analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with single-cell RNA-seq data or .h5ad files.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能够创建、读取、写入和操作 AnnData 对象，支持 .h5ad 和 .zarr 格式，可进行子集提取、合并、转置、类型转换等操作，常用于单细胞数据分析。
howto.when: 当用户需要处理单细胞分析中的 .h5ad 文件，或与 scanpy、scvi-tools 等 scverse 工具集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个 .h5ad 文件，显示数据摘要。
say.note: Claude 会加载文件并展示 AnnData 对象信息。

say.text: 将两个 AnnData 对象按观测轴合并，并添加批次标签。
say.note: Claude 会执行 ad.concat 操作。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to create, read, write, and manipulate AnnData objects, supporting .h5ad and .zarr formats, including subsetting, concatenation, transposition, and type conversion for annotated data matrices.
howto.when_en: Triggered when working with .h5ad files in single-cell analysis or integrating with the scverse ecosystem like scanpy or scvi-tools.

say_en.text: Read this .h5ad file and show a summary of the data.
say_en.note: Claude loads the file and displays AnnData object info.

say_en.text: Concatenate two AnnData objects along observations with batch labels.
